replacementForm.whyNotMkdtempSync: NOT ONE of the 27 sites is a created/written sandbox. Two are read-only probe roots that the arms REQUIRE to be ABSENT (mkdtempSync would create exactly what the arm asserts is missing), and the other 25 are opaque labels/scope values that are never dereferenced (mkdtempSync would leak a directory per site with no cleanup, changing the isolation semantics the task said to keep identical). join(tmpdir(), name) is the repo's own platform-correct helper and creates nothing.
replacementForm.identityProof: On this host TMPDIR is unset so tmpdir() === "/tmp": all 16 DISTINCT replacement expressions evaluate BYTE-IDENTICAL to the literals they replaced (16/16). The change is therefore a semantic NO-OP on Linux and diverges ONLY where tmpdir() diverges (win32, redirected TMPDIR).
replacementForm.win32Mechanism: path.win32.join("/tmp/mpd-home", ".mpd", "workmate") === "\\tmp\\mpd-home\\.mpd\\workmate" — resolved against the CURRENT DRIVE ROOT, not a temp directory.
